Description.description: Free-text description of the stop place

structure_note: The tree combines all StopPlace variants in the examples. A monomodal StopPlace has `TransportMode` and `quays`. A multimodal parent StopPlace groups monomodal children (which point to it with `ParentSiteRef`) and has neither `quays` nor `TransportMode`.
